library.locationDescription: Spiral keeps its database, artwork, and its Tracks folder here.
library.reloadFailed: Spiral folder moved, but reload failed: {{message}}
library.importModeDescription: “Add to Spiral” copies files into the import target source (see Sources). “Keep files where they are” plays them from their current location and never changes them.
library.pathFormatDescription: Organized sources without their own format use this. Changing it doesn't move files already in place.

relocate.hasDatabase: A Spiral folder already exists here. Your current one will stay where it is.
relocate.foundFiles_one: Found {{count}} audio file at {{path}}. Move your current Spiral folder here, or start a new one and import those files in place.
relocate.foundFiles_other: Found {{count}} audio files at {{path}}. Move your current Spiral folder here, or start a new one and import those files in place.
relocate.empty: Or start a new, empty Spiral folder here.

sources.description: Spiral plays music from these folders. Each one can be organized by Spiral, or left exactly as you keep it.
sources.defaultDescription: The Tracks folder inside your Spiral folder.
sources.userDescription: A folder you added. Spiral watches it for changes.
sources.otherDescription: Files added one at a time from elsewhere, played where they are. Spiral never moves them.
sources.offlineHint: Spiral can't reach this folder. Its tracks are marked missing until it's back, or you change its location.
sources.importTargetHint: Files you add to Spiral are copied here.
sources.organizeOnDescription: Spiral renames and sorts files into folders using the path format. Turning this off moves nothing.
sources.organizeOffDescription: Files stay exactly where you keep them. Turning this on shows what would move first.
sources.removeBody_one: Its {{count}} track leaves your library, along with its playlist entries and listening history. The files on disk stay untouched.
sources.removeBody_other: Its {{count}} tracks leave your library, along with their playlist entries and listening history. The files on disk stay untouched.
sources.scanSummary: Scan finished: {{added}} added, {{updated}} updated, {{missing}} missing, {{restored}} found again.

crossfade.description: Overlaps library tracks with a volume ramp. CD transitions still switch instantly.

listening.description: Spiral can record listening history for play counts and personal insights. Your history is yours, stored locally, and never shared with Spiral.
listening.clearAllBody: All personal insights will be permanently lost.

metadata.cdFetch: Fetch album metadata when inserting a CD
metadata.confirmMusicBrainzLinksDescription: Ask before opening a MusicBrainz page in your browser from the editor.
metadata.lyricsAutoFetch: Automatically fetch lyrics in lightbox mode
metadata.lyricsSidecar: Sync timed lyrics to LRC sidecar files
metadata.lyricsSidecarDescription: .lrc files are kept next to track files.
metadata.resetTagWriteWarningsDescription: Show the confirmation again before edits that write tags to your files.

studio.defaultPublisherIdDescription: Seeded into new items as publisherId. Changing this does not rewrite existing items.
studio.slugHint: Use lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens (e.g. jane-doe).

automatic.label: Check for app updates automatically
automatic.description: Check for Spiral updates on launch and every few hours while Spiral is open.

automaticItems.label: Check for pack updates automatically
automaticItems.description: Check for new versions of Studio packs downloaded from the catalog.
